stories.summary: Implement AI Harness Context & Workflow Orchestrator
acceptance_criteria: Resolve canonical ticker symbols from conversational queries and persist turn history.
Return structured narrative, charts, tables, citations, assumptions, and disclaimer.
Reject unapproved tools and malformed ticker symbols with PermissionDeniedError.
Enforce AST pre-check before any Python sandbox execution.
Expose get_quote, get_ohlcv, and get_technical_indicators over MCP.
Compute SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD, ATR, and volume signals.
Expose get_company_profile, get_financial_statements, and get_valuation_and_earnings over MCP.
Include SEC EDGAR CIK and recent 10-K/10-Q/8-K filing metadata with citations.

stories.summary: Build Docker-Isolated Python Sandbox & AST Validator
acceptance_criteria: Block unsafe imports/builtins via AST guard.
Execute code inside ephemeral container with --network none and --read-only.

stories.summary: Configure Celery + Redis Worker & Deep Analysis Task

Persist final AnalysisResponse JSON in database.
